-- Métricas dos últimos 15 minutos
SELECT 
  'interacoes_periodo' as metrica,
  COUNT(*) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM interacoes 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'hitl_pendentes' as metrica,
  COUNT(*) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM interacoes 
WHERE requer_hitl = true 
AND status_hitl = 'pendente'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'visitas_hoje' as metrica,
  COUNT(*) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM visitas 
WHERE DATE(data_hora) = CURRENT_DATE
AND status IN ('agendada', 'confirmada')

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'clientes_ativos' as metrica,
  COUNT(*) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM clientes 
WHERE status = 'ativo'
AND ultima_interacao >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'imoveis_disponiveis' as metrica,
  COUNT(*) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM imoveis 
WHERE status = 'disponivel'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'tempo_resposta_medio' as metrica,
  COALESCE(AVG(tempo_resposta_segundos), 0) as valor,
  NOW() as timestamp
FROM interacoes 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
AND tempo_resposta_segundos IS NOT NULL;

-- Relatório de performance da última hora
WITH metricas_hora AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_interacoes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN requer_hitl = true THEN 1 END) as interacoes_hitl,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN canal = 'whatsapp' THEN 1 END) as interacoes_whatsapp,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN canal = 'email' THEN 1 END) as interacoes_email,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tempo_resposta_segundos IS NOT NULL THEN tempo_resposta_segundos END) as tempo_resposta_medio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cliente_id) as clientes_unicos
  FROM interacoes 
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
),
visitas_hora AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as visitas_agendadas,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'realizada' THEN 1 END) as visitas_realizadas,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelada' THEN 1 END) as visitas_canceladas
  FROM visitas 
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
),
imoveis_novos AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as imoveis_cadastrados
  FROM imoveis 
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
)
SELECT 
  m.*,
  v.*,
  i.*,
  NOW() as timestamp_relatorio
FROM metricas_hora m
CROSS JOIN visitas_hora v
CROSS JOIN imoveis_novos i;

-- Limpeza e manutenção diária

-- 1. Limpar logs antigos
DELETE FROM logs_sistema 
WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

-- 2. Limpar rate limiting antigo
DELETE FROM rate_limiting 
WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';

-- 3. Atualizar scores de clientes ativos
UPDATE clientes 
SET score_qualificacao = calcular_score_cliente(id)
WHERE status = 'ativo' 
AND ultima_interacao >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

-- 4. Marcar clientes inativos
UPDATE clientes 
SET status = 'inativo'
WHERE status = 'ativo' 
AND ultima_interacao < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';

-- 5. Limpar agenda antiga
DELETE FROM agenda_disponivel 
WHERE data_hora_inicio < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';

-- 6. Gerar estatísticas de limpeza
SELECT 
  'limpeza_concluida' as operacao,
  NOW() as timestamp,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs_sistema 
    WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ) as logs_mantidos,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clientes 
    WHERE status = 'ativo'
  ) as clientes_ativos,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clientes 
    WHERE status = 'inativo'
  ) as clientes_inativos;
